commands:
set -e
printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$PATH"
for c in qemu-system-x86_64 qemu-system-i386 qemu-system-aarch64 telnet nc socat timeout; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s=%s\n' "$c" "$(command -v "$c")" || true; done
ls -l /app/alpine.iso 2>/dev/null || true
file /app/alpine.iso 2>/dev/null || true
